premises: Enamel-like dual-phase microstructures with stabilized nanoscale phase boundaries can be created in refractory HEAs via severe plastic deformation and partial annealing.
Such boundaries activate atomic plane migration, promote continuous dislocation activation, and provide displacement plasticity space.
This mechanism alleviates strain localization and stabilizes the work-hardening rate.
These effects will persist under adiabatic dynamic loading at 10^3–10^4 s⁻¹.
The specific processing (SPD + 900°C/10 min anneal) will yield ~15% dynamic strength increase and ~5% uniform strain improvement in HfZrTiTa0.53.
